init_process_tracing: initialize OpenTelemetry tracing with an OTLP endpoint and server name for distributed request tracing
create_trace_req_context: create a TraceReqContext instance to manage request-level OpenTelemetry spans and slices
set_thread_trace_info: set thread-level tracing metadata including thread label, TP rank, and DP rank for span attribution
extract_trace_headers: extract traceparent and tracestate headers from an incoming request mapping for context propagation
set_global_trace_level: set the global tracing level to control the depth of slice-level spans that are recorded
